human_instruction: Updated human route instruction, replacing the earlier high horizontal-centering then vertical-descent plan: You are continuing at the human-selected checkpoint800, before reaching the desired placement position. Keep the restart EEF world-X position and orientation; do not add a new world-X shift to chase the bottle mouth or the wrist image center. Approach mainly in world negative Y while descending in world negative Z, so that the BOTTLE BASE reaches the center of the cabinet OUTER TOP near the end of the descent. Use the three current images to judge the approach and landing point. Do not first move over the center at a large height and then re-center sideways during lowering. Once supported, open fully and retreat in world positive Z with horizontal position and orientation held. Request one operation and reobserve. No object coordinates, height-to-surface values, center-error scores, or future recorded actions are provided.
